answer: Sybil resistance works when claims must be decrypted into evidence before anyone is paid. Every agent submits its work under a cipher that peers can open: results are replayed independently, and only reproducible output counts. Influence then moves with the tide of verified contributions rather than raw account count, so a clone army gains nothing. Reputation grows like a grove, rooted in history that cannot be transplanted, while masks without checkable work rot where they stand.
